Grit ek kabhi na rukne wala dil.
Chuppi takat ka srot hai.
Grit pain ko purpose banata.
Khamoshi power ki language hai.
Jeetne ke liye, tumhe ek battle ko ek se zyada dafa ladna pad sakta hai.
Bahadur dil free dil hota hai.
Kabhi kabhi silence sabse best answer hota hai.
Himmat sword nikali hui mohabbat hai.
Bahadur insaan kabhi akela nahi hota.
Hausla aur himmat ek saath—jore ki tarah.
Chup rehne mein hi hum apne aap ko paate hain.
Himmat raste banati hai.
Himmat kunji hai.
Sirf bolo agar khamoshi behtar ho jaye.
Khamoshi ultimate weapon hai.
Humare piche aur aage ka sab chhota hai—compared to inside.
Quietness ultimate conquest hai.
Mehnat hunar ko maat deti hai.
Grit grit hi hai.
Mind empty, formless, shapeless—jaise paani.
Grit mein sabr chahiye.
Sher khamoshi se ladta hai.
